claims.claim: Retail eyewear has carried price markups of up to roughly 1,000% over production cost, consistent with a retail price tens of times the material floor.
claims.episode_span: A three-hundred-dollar retail pair therefore carries an Idiot Index somewhere between forty and one hundred.
claims.supporting_quote: Luxottica's market power has allowed it to charge price markups of up to 1000%.

claims.claim: Good-quality eyeglass frames can be produced for a few dollars (about $4-$8 at factory level, per LensCrafters' founder).
claims.episode_span: Acetate or titanium frame stock adds another one to two dollars depending on the alloy or polymer chosen.
claims.supporting_quote: You can get amazingly good frames, with a Warby Parker level of quality, for $4 to $8. For $15, you can get designer-quality frames

claims.claim: First-quality eyeglass lenses can be bought for on the order of a dollar apiece, supporting a sub-dollar polymer cost per lens.
claims.episode_span: a finished pair of lenses might use forty to sixty grams once edging waste is counted, placing the polymer cost well under one dollar.
claims.source_title: Engineering a monopoly: how to not get ripped off on your eyeglasses - Interesting Engineering
claims.supporting_quote: Butler goes on to say, “You can buy absolutely first-quality lenses for $1.25 apiece.

claims.claim: Commodity polycarbonate resin trades in the low dollars per kilogram (about $2-$3.4/kg by region, Aug 2026).
claims.episode_span: Commodity polycarbonate pellets trade in the low dollars per kilogram
claims.supporting_quote: Polycarbonate price August 2026 and outlook (see chart below) North America:US$2.91/KG, 1% up Europe:US$3.41/KG, 13.3% up

claims.claim: An eyeglass prescription is generated by a refraction eye exam performed by a licensed prescriber, who must give the patient a copy of it.
claims.episode_span: The conventional path begins with a refraction exam performed by an optometrist or ophthalmologist whose time and equipment must be compensated, often under rules that tie the prescription release to the same visit.
claims.source_title: Buying Prescription Glasses or Contact Lenses: Your Rights | Consumer Advice
claims.supporting_quote: For glasses, your prescriber must give you a copy immediately after you get an eye exam that includes a refraction

claims.claim: Frame wholesale costs include brand licensing fees paid to fashion houses (Luxottica licenses frames for Chanel, Prada, Armani, Burberry, Versace and others).
claims.episode_span: the patient selects frames from a limited in-store inventory whose wholesale cost already includes brand licensing fees paid to fashion houses.
claims.supporting_quote: licensing prescription and non-prescription sunglasses frames for many luxury and designer brands including Chanel , Prada , Giorgio Armani , Burberry , Versace

claims.claim: Most plastic eyeglass lenses are made from polymers such as CR-39, polycarbonate, or Trivex.
claims.episode_span: The lenses themselves are molded from a few grams of polycarbonate or similar polymer
claims.source_title: Engineering a monopoly: how to not get ripped off on your eyeglasses - Interesting Engineering
claims.supporting_quote: Most plastic eyeglass lenses are made out of Columbia Resin #39, which is a plastic polymer, polycarbonate, or Trivex
